mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during easing periods than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high housing starts and low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of high industrial production than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low federal funds rate and high money supply.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high payroll employment.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index and an increase in GDP signal a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low consumer price index and high GDP.
